sources.title: MN 86 Aṅgulimālasutta: With Aṅgulimāla (Bhikkhu Sujato translation, CC0)
sources.edition: Bhikkhu Sujato, Middle Discourses 86 (SuttaCentral Bilara, MN 86)

entities.name: Aṅgulimāla paritta (protective verse)
aliases: Aṅgulimāla Sutta chanted for pregnant women

facts.subject: angulimala
facts.object: bandit in the realm of King Pasenadi of Kosala
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, Aṅgulimāla là một tên cướp trong vương quốc của vua Pasenadi xứ Kosala.

evidence.span: Now at that time in the realm of King Pasenadi of Kosala there was a bandit named Aṅgulimāla.
in King Pasenadi's realm there was a bandit named Angulimala

facts.subject: angulimala
facts.object: wore the fingers of those he killed as a necklace/garland
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, Aṅgulimāla đeo ngón tay người bị giết làm vòng cổ (Sujato: necklace; Thanissaro: garland (mala) of fingers (anguli)).

evidence.span: He was constantly murdering humans, and he wore their fingers as a necklace.
Having repeatedly killed human beings, he wore a garland (mala) made of fingers (anguli).

facts.subject: buddha
facts.object: walked on in silence down the road to Aṅgulimāla despite repeated warnings from herdsmen and farmers
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, các người chăn bò, nông dân can ngăn, Đức Phật vẫn im lặng đi tiếp trên con đường dẫn đến Aṅgulimāla.

evidence.span: But when they said this, the Buddha went on in silence.
he walked down the road that led to Aṅgulimāla.

facts.subject: buddha
facts.object: willed with psychic power that Aṅgulimāla could not catch up though the Buddha walked at normal pace
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, Đức Phật dùng thần thông khiến Aṅgulimāla không đuổi kịp dù Ngài đi bình thường.

evidence.span: But the Buddha used his psychic power to will that Aṅgulimāla could not catch up with him no matter how hard he tried, even though the Buddha kept walking at a normal speed.
Then the Blessed One willed a feat of psychic power such that Angulimala, though running with all his might, could not catch up with the Blessed One walking at normal pace.

facts.subject: buddha
facts.object: "I've stopped, Aṅgulimāla - now you stop."
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, Đức Phật nói: "Ta đã dừng rồi, Aṅgulimāla — ngươi hãy dừng lại."

evidence.span: “I’ve stopped, Aṅgulimāla—now you stop.”
"I have stopped, Angulimala. You stop."

facts.subject: buddha
facts.object: he has forever stopped, laid aside violence toward all creatures; Aṅgulimāla cannot stop harming living creatures
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, Đức Phật giải thích: Ngài đã dừng vĩnh viễn, buông bỏ bạo lực với mọi loài; còn Aṅgulimāla chưa dừng làm hại chúng sinh.

evidence.span: I’ve laid aside violence toward all creatures.
I have stopped, Angulimala, once & for all, having cast off violence toward all living beings.

facts.subject: angulimala
facts.object: hurled his sword and weapons down a cliff and requested the going forth
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, Aṅgulimāla quăng gươm khí giới xuống vực, đảnh lễ chân Phật và xin xuất gia.

evidence.span: the bandit hurled his sword and weapons
and requested the going forth right away.

facts.subject: buddha
facts.object: "Come, monk!" - and with that Aṅgulimāla became a monk
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, Đức Phật nói "Hãy đến, tỳ-khưu!" và Aṅgulimāla thành tỳ-khưu.

evidence.span: said to him, “Come, monk!”
And with that he became a monk.
the teacher of the world, along with its devas, said to him then: "Come, bhikkhu."

facts.subject: pasenadi
facts.object: drove out with around five hundred horses toward the monastery to deal with Aṅgulimāla
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, vua Pasenadi xuất hành giữa trưa cùng khoảng năm trăm kỵ mã đến tinh xá.

evidence.span: Then King Pasenadi drove out from Sāvatthī in the middle of the day with around five hundred horses,

facts.subject: pasenadi
facts.object: he could not tame him with rod and sword, but the Buddha tamed him without rod or sword
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, vua Pasenadi thừa nhận không thể thu phục bằng gậy gươm, còn Đức Phật thu phục không cần gậy gươm.

evidence.span: For I was not able to tame him with the rod and the sword, but the Buddha tamed him without rod or sword.

facts.subject: angulimala
facts.object: his father was a Gagga and his mother a Mantāṇī
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, Aṅgulimāla nói cha là Gagga và mẹ là Mantāṇī.

evidence.span: “My father was a Gagga, and my mother a Mantāṇī.”
"My father is a Gagga, great king, and my mother a Mantani."

facts.subject: angulimala
facts.object: saw a woman undergoing a distressing obstructed labor (Sujato)
facts.statement_vi: Theo bản dịch Sujato, Aṅgulimāla thấy một phụ nữ đang chuyển dạ khó, bị tắc nghẽn.

evidence.span: he saw a woman undergoing a distressing obstructed labor.

facts.subject: angulimala
facts.object: saw a woman suffering a breech birth (Thanissaro)
facts.statement_vi: Theo bản dịch Thanissaro, Aṅgulimāla thấy một phụ nữ sinh ngược (breech birth).

evidence.span: he saw a woman suffering a breech birth.

facts.subject: buddha
facts.object: tells Aṅgulimāla to say: since I was born in the noble birth I do not recall intentionally taking a living creature's life; by this truth may you and your baby be safe
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, Đức Phật dạy Aṅgulimāla nói với sản phụ: từ khi sinh ra trong dòng thánh, tôi không nhớ cố ý sát sinh; nhờ lời thật này mong mẹ con bình an.

evidence.span: Ever since I was born in the noble birth, sister, I don’t recall having intentionally taken the life of a living creature. By this truth, may both you and your baby be safe.
since I was born in the noble birth, I do not recall intentionally killing a living being.

facts.subject: woman_labor
facts.object: the woman and her baby were safe after Aṅgulimāla spoke the words
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, sản phụ và đứa bé được bình an.

evidence.span: Then that woman was safe, and so was her baby.
And there was wellbeing for the woman, wellbeing for her fetus.

facts.subject: angulimala
facts.object: became one of the perfected (arahant)
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, Aṅgulimāla chứng quả A-la-hán.

evidence.span: And Venerable Aṅgulimāla became one of the perfected.

facts.subject: angulimala
facts.object: was hit by a stone, a stick and gravel thrown by people when he went for alms; the Buddha told him to endure it
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, khi đi khất thực, Aṅgulimāla bị người ném đá, gậy, sỏi; Phật bảo ngài hãy nhẫn chịu.

evidence.span: Now at that time someone threw a stone that hit Aṅgulimāla, someone else threw a stick, and someone else threw gravel.
“Endure it, brahmin! Endure it, brahmin!

facts.subject: angulimala
facts.object: "My name is Harmless, though I used to be harmful"
facts.statement_vi: Theo MN 86, trong kệ cảm hứng Aṅgulimāla nói tên ngài là "Vô Hại" dù xưa là kẻ gây hại.

evidence.span: My name is ‘Harmless’,
though I used to be harmful.

facts.subject: angulimala_paritta
facts.object: recited during blessings for pregnant women in Theravāda countries
facts.statement_vi: Theo Wikipedia (nguồn phụ): bài kệ của Aṅgulimāla (Aṅgulimāla paritta) được tụng khi chúc phúc cho phụ nữ mang thai ở các nước Theravāda.

condition.text: tụng khi chúc phúc cho phụ nữ mang thai ở các nước Theravāda
condition.outcome: tụng bài kệ Aṅgulimāla (paritta) cầu bình an sinh nở

qualifiers.scope: tục lệ Theravāda hiện nay, theo nguồn phụ

evidence.span: Monastics continue to recite the text during blessings for pregnant women in Theravāda countries

facts.subject: angulimala
facts.object: collected fingers toward a count of one hundred (some versions)
facts.statement_vi: Theo Wikipedia: một số dị bản nói trăm ngón tay, số khác nói nghìn; MN 86 không nêu con số.

evidence.span: Some versions of the story mention hundred fingers, while others mention thousand.

facts.subject: angulimala
facts.object: collected fingers toward a count of one thousand (some versions; Dhammapāla)
facts.statement_vi: Theo Wikipedia: Dhammapāla nói Aṅgulimāla phải lấy một nghìn ngón tay phải; MN 86 không nêu con số.

evidence.span: Dhammapāla states that Aṅgulimāla is required to fetch a thousand fingers from right hands

facts.subject: buddhaghosa
facts.object: father named the child Ahiṃsaka, meaning the harmless one
facts.statement_vi: Theo Wikipedia (dẫn Buddhaghosa): cha đặt tên con là Ahiṃsaka, nghĩa là "người vô hại"; không có trong MN 86.

evidence.span: Buddhaghosa relates that the father names the child Ahiṃsaka, meaning 'the harmless one'.
